summary: Opt-in read-after-write receipts and reactive IVM waits

replay.detail: No read/open backfill or catch-up is enabled.

schema.detail: Uses the explicitly installed IVM event identity, source cut and existing claims primary key.

compatibility.detail: Adds Rust APIs and a runnable example without routes or consumer migration. Local receipt identity is strict; foreign mapping is explicit.

manual.detail: Adopters supply deadline/cancellation, certified source adapter and same-snapshot authority checks. See IVM_AFTER_WRITE.md.

recovery.detail: Epoch/position/provider gaps require explicit resync. Production restore, checkpoint and authority coverage remain adapter gates.
